    Start a funded deal

    Your wallet approves the token, then locks the full total in the contract. Nobody can move it except by the rules below.

    Milestones

    Deliver this milestone

    Paste a link to the work or a short delivery note. Only its fingerprint (a hash) goes on-chain; you choose who sees the text.

    Release ?

    This pays the freelancer for and moves the deal to the next milestone. It can't be undone.

    Freeze this deal?

    Nothing moves until the arbiter decides. If the arbiter hasn't acted after 14 days, either side can settle: delivered work splits 50/50, undelivered work goes back to the client.

    Decide milestone

    Choose how much of this milestone () the freelancer earned. Everything else still in escrow goes back to the client.

    Open a deal by number

    Use another ScopePay contract

    For reviewers and forks. The app checks the address is a ScopePay v2 contract before reading it. This isn't saved; reload to return to the default.
